_comment: ⚠️ STARTERPACK CORE — DO NOT MODIFY. This file is managed by the starterpack.
name: website-starter-pack

scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run dev
scripts.lint:backend: cd app/backend && ruff check src/ tests/ --config ruff.toml
scripts.lint:backend:fix: cd app/backend && ruff check src/ tests/ --config ruff.toml --fix
scripts.format:backend: cd app/backend && ruff format src/ tests/ --config ruff.toml
scripts.test:e2e:start: COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-app}-e2e PUBLIC_PORT=13001 USE_TLS= DOCKER_UID=$(id -u) DOCKER_GID=$(id -g) DOCKER_USER=$USER docker compose --env-file .env.ci -f docker-compose.core.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml --profile dev up -d --build
scripts.test:e2e:stop: COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-app}-e2e docker compose --env-file .env.ci -f docker-compose.core.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml --profile dev down
scripts.test:e2e: cd app/frontend && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:13001 npm run test:e2e

author: 7PH <b.raymond@protonmail.com>
